report.value: The data-line diodes of pins 1, 3, 4 and 6 steer to the VBUS clamp on pin 5. The application note gives the isolation only 'as long as the signal voltage on the data lines is between the ground- and the VBUS-level'. The IO board runs from the DC input or the pack with no USB source present, so VBUS is then absent. A D+ or CC line held above it then forward-biases into the VBUS net. The current into that net is not stated and not measured
